fullText:
Disney invoked a Disney+ free trial to try to keep a widower’s wrongful-death claim against it out of court.​

Dr. Kanokporn Tangsuan died on October 5, 2023, after dining at independently operated Raglan Road in Disney Springs.​ Disney argued that her husband’s “Agree & Continue” click accepted broader terms, then cited his website reliance and later park-ticket purchase to connect those terms to the claim. It sought individual arbitration—a private decision-maker instead of a courtroom—not immunity from liability.

Receipt: Orange County, Florida, case 2024-CA-001616-O; Disney’s May 31, 2024 motion, Filing # 199635248, cites Terms of Use §7 and quotes the Subscriber Agreement: “any dispute between You and Us, Except for Small Claims, is subject to a class action waiver and must be resolved by individual binding arbitration”. Disney abandoned arbitration in August 2024 after public backlash; Jeffrey Piccolo voluntarily dismissed the lawsuit on February 27, 2026.

Before clicking accept, save the linked terms. Check what “dispute” covers, which affiliated companies it includes, and whether it reaches other services. A company’s arbitration demand is not a court ruling.
